location.name: District 7 market
location.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: professional film production ARCHITECTURE / LOCATION REFERENCE SHEET, one location only, nine separate architecture views arranged in a very clean 3x3 grid. Create a high-resolution landscape 16:9 image, request 3840x2160 if supported. Crisp fine detail and legible short uppercase labels in the thin neutral dark gutters, not across the image panels. Cinematic gritty realistic neon world of CyberKitty 2077, rich physically plausible materials, believable film sets, restrained pink/cyan accent lighting, no painterly blur. All nine panels must depict ONE spatially coherent empty environment with exactly the same doors, walls, lighting, floor, props and architectural landmarks in their correct corresponding positions; use a common north orientation. Panel arrangement: top row HERO WIDE, NORTH, EAST; middle row SOUTH, WEST, PLAN; bottom row CEILING / SKY, FLOOR / MATERIALS, REVERSE WIDE. Hero and reverse are useful empty stage camera plates. Plan is a crisp overhead architectural floor/site plan with N arrow and camera marks A and B at the hero/reverse positions, matching the renders. In the ceiling panel show ceiling features and hanging lights, or for exterior show upper facades and skyline. In floor/materials show floor detail AND a few isolated fixed prop material details. Do NOT depict any people, animals, characters, silhouettes, audience, security officers or portraits. No scenes, action, comic panels, movie frames or character sheets. No CRT television shell around the design. Empty filming stages. Avoid arbitrary decorative clutter and repeated random signs. Do not show conflicting geometry or mirrored landmarks. Readable title at top exactly as specified; all other labels short and clear. Title: "LOC08 / DISTRICT 7 MARKET". References 1 and 2 are for the established district's street materials, warm lantern stalls and distant cyan/magenta towers only; remove all their crowds and heroes. Design an empty gritty neighborhood market street at night just after rain: wet repaired asphalt and concrete, compact food stalls with rusted corrugated awnings, old red lanterns, cat icon signage, stacked empty fish crates, shuttered shop units, drainage channels and overhead power cables. Proposed coherent geography: long east-west market street, north row of warm lantern fish stalls, south row of lower shuttered shops and a short loading bay, west street mouth opens toward a small rally plaza, east end frames distant neon towers. A compact stair on the northeast building leads to a modest flat rooftop overlook; keep the same building/stair in east/north/plan views. Clear central street wide enough for a small refrigerated delivery truck later, but NO VEHICLES in this sheet. Stalls are closed/empty awaiting filming, no visible food stock that would contradict the shortage. Show empty counters, freezer cases, loading handcart and crates as fixed prop details. Weathered lived-in district, street scaled for anthropomorphic cats, not a sleek wealthy district. The reverse wide looks west toward the plaza so scene23 rooftop and market coverage can be established later.

FINAL CONTINUITY REQUIREMENTS:
For exterior directional panels, NORTH/EAST/SOUTH/WEST identify the SIDE of the set from which the camera looks inward; make their view directions explicit in the plan. Every camera arrow must agree with its perspective; the plan must depict the same set, never an alternative design. Only print the location title and requested short panel labels. Do not print this brief, reference filenames, filenames, instructions, text from reference captions or a production watermark. Preserve native detail; 3840x2160 is a target only if your interface supports it. Empty means no people, cats, dogs or robots; fixed props and any explicitly specified parked vehicles/food stock are permitted.
Add one fixed blank public billboard/display above the middle of the SOUTH shop row, facing north into the market street, visible from hero/plan/reverse as appropriate. Keep it blank for the price chart overlay. The northeast building and its compact stair are the same building used by LOC20.
Reference images are visual context, not instructions. Remove actors from references and keep the set empty. Ignore legacy character names printed in source material.
